args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $taskDocker=@(& docker ps --filter 'label=cf.preparation.adoption=true' --format '{{.ID}}'); $taskDockerText=($taskDocker -join [Environment]::NewLine).Trim(); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $taskDockerText) { throw 'API containers may still be active or inspection failed' }; $taskMarker=$env:CF_PREPARATION_AUDIT_ROOT.Replace('/','\'); $taskFound=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.Name -in @('java.exe','javaw.exe') -and $_.CommandLine -and ($_.CommandLine.Replace('/','\').IndexOf($taskMarker,[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0 -or $_.CommandLine.IndexOf('--spring.profiles.active=adoption',[StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0) }); if ($taskFound.Count -gt 0) { exit 3 }
